snippet.title: Alien Bloom – Official Gameplay Trailer | 3-Player Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Alien Bloom on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133680/Alien_Bloom/

Alien Bloom is a free-to-play three-player strategy game where rival factions fight for control of Earth. Expand into new territory, attack your enemies, and use card games to decide every battle.

Choose from four asymmetrical factions, seize powerful world-map bonuses, and escalate the war from Earth to space and into the 5th Dimension.

Be the first player to control five territories in a row and claim the world.

Coming to Steam August 12, 2026.
Available now on the App Store and Google Play.

Official website: AlienBloom.com

#AlienBloom #StrategyGame #IndieGame
